name: MOCHAKK
bio_excerpt: Mochakk (Pedro Maia) is a Brazilian DJ and producer from Sorocaba, born 1999. He started DJing around Sao Paulo at 15, launched the MOTRAXX label in 2022 and debuted at DC-10 with Circoloco. In 2024 he opened the club OBLIQO in Sorocaba.

name: ESA
bio_excerpt: Esa Williams is a DJ and producer born in Cape Flats, South Africa, and based in London. He was Saturday night resident at Phonox, plays band leader for Ghanaian musician Ata Kak, and curated the Soundway compilation Esa Presents Amandla in 2019. He played Magnetic Fields in India that year.

name: ROSS FROM FRIENDS
bio_excerpt: Ross From Friends is Felix Clary Weatherall, from Brightlingsea in Essex, England. He makes house and dub techno and records for Brainfeeder. His albums are Family Portrait (2018) and Tread (2021).

Love Divide / The Knife (Bubble Love Remixes) (2024, Brainfeeder)

name: MIDNIGHT TRAFFIC
bio_excerpt: Midnight Traffic is a Hyderabad-based electronic duo and techno visionary, creating hypnotic soundscapes with modern design, deep elements, and pulsating rhythms. Active in the Hyderabad electronic scene and regional scene builders. Performed at Boiler Room Hyderabad in May 2022 alongside Nikki Nair

name: MASALO
bio_excerpt: Masalo is a DJ and producer from Amsterdam, born and raised there with roots in Japan. His sets move between house, techno, hi-NRG and disco. He runs the Brighter Days party with Kamma, is connected to Rush Hour, and released his debut EP New Dance in 2019.
sample_releases: Can't Fake The Feeling (Radio Mix) (2026, Brighter Discs)
For Your Love (Kamma & Masalo Radio Mix) (2022, Rush Hour)

name: YUNG.RAJ
bio_excerpt: Electronic and hip-hop crossover. Magnetic Fields, NH7.

name: ANUSHKA
bio_excerpt: Anushka Menon is a Goa-based DJ and former fashion and beauty photographer. She is one half of the duo Anushka + Agent with Smita Singh, a co-founder of Magnetic Fields. Her Wild City #235 mix, recorded at JUNA, was released on 28 May 2024.

name: DEENA ABDELWAHED
bio_excerpt: Deena Abdelwahed is a Tunisian producer and DJ based in Paris. Her debut EP Klabb came out on InFiné in 2017, followed by the album Khonnar in 2018. She plays club and electronic music, from industrial techno to Arabic rhythms like mahraganat and dabke.

name: DJ RAVETEK
bio_excerpt: First Indian signed to Tiesto's Musical Freedom label.

name: DWELL
bio_excerpt: Played CCD Episode 4 at Bar Wild.

name: HAAi
bio_excerpt: HAAi (Teneil Throssell) is an Australian-born DJ and producer based in London. She plays techno, house and leftfield club music and has released on Mute and !K7, including DJ-Kicks: HAAi in 2023. Her BBC Radio 1 Essential Mix was named Essential Mix of the Year 2018.

name: JAEL
bio_excerpt: Giovanni Jaël Jano, known as JAEL, is a Moluccan DJ, producer and vocalist from the Netherlands, based in Amsterdam. He is a long-time member of the Soulection collective. He released the EP Motion Sickness in 2025 and played Magnetic Fields in India in 2019.

name: KARENN
bio_excerpt: Karenn is a UK duo of Blawan and Pariah, formed in 2011 after they met releasing on R&S Records. They make and perform techno using analogue hardware. Their debut album Grapefruit Regret came out in 2019 on their label Voam.

name: MIXTRESS
bio_excerpt: Mixtress is Rukmini Mukherjee, known as Rini, a DJ and Rinse FM resident. Her sets centre on jungle, hardcore and footwork. She grew up mostly in Amsterdam, moved to the UK at 18, and lived in India until about age three. She played Magnetic Fields in December 2023.

name: SHIREEN
bio_excerpt: Shireen is a Delhi DJ and a member of the all-femme collective Coven Code. Her sets draw on UK club culture, mixing house and techno with UK garage, breakbeat and dubstep.
